title: Full parameter-root tower maps and deck characters
statement: Let $p$ be a prime, $R$ a commutative ring and $J$ a finite set with $t:J\to R$. Reindex the actual compatible-root algebra of [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module] along $J\simeq\{0,\ldots,|J|-1\}$; its roots are the quotient generators and its spectrum over an affine $U$ has the structural map induced by $R\to R[t_i^{1/n}]$. Write $G_{p,J}=(\prod_{q\text{ prime},q\ne p}\mathbf Z_q)^J$ with its product topology and multiplicative notation for addition. Compatible deck characters on $R$ consist of primitive roots $\zeta_n$ for all positive prime-to-$p$ orders, with $\zeta_m^{m/n}=\zeta_n$ when $n\mid m$, and continuous homomorphisms $G_{p,J}\to(\mathbf Z/n)^J$ taking each integral vector to its ordinary residue vector. For a finite family of component ideal sheaves $C_a$ on a scheme [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], the reduced stratum is the reduced intersection for $a\in I$ restricted to the open complement of components outside $I$. A parameter family cuts out each pulled-back component ideal scheme-theoretically. The stratum and open are reindexings of the recorded sncStratumIdeal and sncStratumOpen of [lem-sfb-snc-universal-residual-charts], not independent definitions of their scheme structures. These define the canonical root maps and root global sections used below.
